result.topic_en: Calculation of the mixed second derivative of log m with respect to t and T, expressed through second and first derivatives of m with respect to p and q and coefficients A, B, C, a, b, c and their primed counterparts, rewritten in terms of E, F, G.
result.transcription:
Math 29 \quad (5) [-48g/-] 5 \quad a

$\frac{dd\log m}{dt\,dT} = -\frac{aA}{hh}\frac{ddm}{m\,dq^2} + \frac{aB+bA}{hh}\frac{ddm}{m\,dp.dq} - \frac{bB}{hhm}\frac{ddm}{dp^2}$

$+\frac{1}{h^3m}\left\{A\frac{dm}{dq} - B\frac{dm}{dp}\right\}\left\{\begin{array}{l}A(ac'-bb')+B(ab'-ba')\\ +A'bb-2B'ab+C'aa\end{array}\right\}$

$\left(-\frac{bB'}{hh}+\frac{aC'}{hh}\right)\frac{dm}{m\,dp} + \left(\frac{bA'-aB'}{hh}\right)\frac{dm}{m\,dq}$

$+\frac{1}{mmhh}\left(A\frac{dm}{dq} - B\frac{dm}{dp}\right)\left\{-\frac{b\,dm}{dp}+\frac{a\,dm}{dq}\right\}$

$=\left\{-E\frac{ddm}{dq^2} + 2F\frac{ddm}{dp\,dq} - G\frac{ddm}{dp^2}\right\}\frac{1}{mhh}$

$+\frac{1}{h^3m}\left\{A\frac{dm}{dq} - B\frac{dm}{dp}\right\}\left\{\begin{array}{l}A'bb-2B'ab+C'aa\\ -a'bB+b'(aB-bA)-c'aA\end{array}\right\}$

$+\frac{1}{hh}(-bB'+aC')\frac{dm}{m\,dp} + \frac{1}{hh}(bA'-aB')\frac{dm}{m\,dq}$

$+\frac{1}{m^3hh}\left\{E\left(\frac{dm}{dq}\right)^2 - 2F\frac{dm}{dp}\frac{dm}{dq} + G\left(\frac{dm}{dp}\right)^2\right\}$

$E\frac{ddm}{dq^2} - 2F\frac{ddm}{dp\,dq} + G\frac{ddm}{dp^2}$
